Maize Opaque-2 Genomic DNA Sequence

Source: R/data.R
opaque2.Rd

The genomic nucleotide sequence of the maize (Zea mays) opaque endosperm 2 gene, NCBI Gene ID 542375, also known as o2 or Opaque-2.

Usage

opaque2

Format

A character vector of length 3,158. Each element is one nucleotide, encoded as "A", "C", "G", or "T", in genomic order. Counts are 798 A, 755 C, 765 G, and 840 T. There are no missing or ambiguous bases.

Source

Reference Sequence (RefSeq) database, National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI), U.S. National Library of Medicine, National Institutes of Health. See the RefSeq chromosome 7 record (NC_050102.1) and the NCBI Gene record (542375).

Details

The gene is annotated as LOC542375 on chromosome 7 of the maize assembly Zm-B73-REFERENCE-NAM-5.0 (GCF_902167145.1) in NCBI Zea mays Annotation Release 103 (2020-08-09). The sequence is the plus strand of the inclusive interval 10,951,530–10,954,687 on RefSeq NC_050102.1. Element \(k\) corresponds to the one-based chromosome coordinate \(10951529 + k\). The genomic interval includes introns.

Retrieving the sequence

The dataset can be retrieved as FASTA from NCBI RefSeq via EFetch using the accession, coordinates, and strand specified above.

See also

fit(), test_prob()

Examples

data(opaque2)
head(opaque2)
#> [1] "A" "A" "T" "C" "C" "A"
table(opaque2)
#> opaque2
#>   A   C   G   T 
#> 798 755 765 840 
fit(opaque2)
#> Markov Chain
#>   Number of states: 4 
#> 
#>   Initial distribution (a):
#>     A T C G 
#>     1 0 0 0 
#> 
#>   Transition matrix (P):
#>               A         T         C         G
#>     A 0.2446675 0.2609787 0.2308657 0.2634881
#>     T 0.2321429 0.2857143 0.2214286 0.2607143
#>     C 0.2860927 0.2860927 0.2264901 0.2013245
#>     G 0.2496732 0.2300654 0.2797386 0.2405229

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
refseq_url <- paste0(
  "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/efetch.fcgi?",
  "db=nuccore&id=NC_050102.1&strand=1",
  "&seq_start=10951530&seq_stop=10954687&rettype=fasta&retmode=text"
)
fasta <- readLines(refseq_url)
sequence <- paste0(fasta[-1L], collapse = "")
bases <- strsplit(sequence, "", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
stopifnot(identical(bases, opaque2))
} # }
